# Functional Python

Use pure functions, immutable domain values, explicit capabilities, and typed Results. Never author `raise` or `try`/`except` application control flow. Apply this pack to Python source and examples.

Read `bytefarm/engineering` through the installation index first. Use `returns` for typed failure and composition; its documented decorator/composition typing requires the compatible mypy plugin. A recommendation is not dependency installation authorization.
